blocks.p: trait = partager du code SANS heritage. Comble le manque d'heritage multiple.

blocks.code:
<?php
trait Timestamps {
    public ?DateTime $createdAt = null;
    public ?DateTime $updatedAt = null;

    public function touch(): void {
        if (!$this->createdAt) $this->createdAt = new DateTime();
        $this->updatedAt = new DateTime();
    }
}

trait SoftDelete {
    public ?DateTime $deletedAt = null;
    public function delete(): void {
        $this->deletedAt = new DateTime();
    }
}

class User {
    use Timestamps, SoftDelete;
}

$u = new User();
$u->touch();
$u->delete();

blocks.tip: Cas typique : Timestamps, Loggable, HasUuid, SoftDelete partages entre modeles.

opts: Partager code entre classes non liees
quiz.expl: Mutualiser du code entre classes sans parent commun.
